name: OverflowMenuItem

props.name: closeMenu
props.description: A callback to tell the parent menu component that the menu should be closed.

props.name: dangerDescription
props.description: Specify the message read by screen readers for the danger overflow menu item variant

props.name: disabled
props.description: `true` to make this menu item disabled.

props.name: hasDivider
props.description: `true` to make this menu item a divider.

props.name: href
props.description: If given, overflow item will render as a link with the given href

props.name: isDelete
props.description: `true` to make this menu item a danger button.

props.name: itemText
props.description: The text to show for the menu item

props.name: wrapperClassName
props.description: The CSS class name to be placed on the wrapper element

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon OverflowMenuItem rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
